concepts.why: Secular scholar / biblical-theological reader: the name says the ground is cursed. Gen 3:17-18, 5:29 and 8:21 say so of the ground. Gen 4:11-12 says Cain is cursed and banished from the ground, and the ground will not yield to him; the ground itself is not called cursed there. The verse is already carried by the concept 'Cast out of His presence' (Gen 4:14, 4:16) and the Cain secondary line. Dropping it leaves four passages (three, if the owner prefers) that all say what the name says.

Secular scholar / Reformed / Catholic: the name says people were cast out of His presence. Ps 51:11 is a petition, 'Cast me not away from Your presence', and does not say David was cast out. It is the same kind of failure as 2 Kgs 13:23, which an earlier round dropped for saying the opposite. Psalm 51 is already under four other concepts (4, 9, 11, 16) and the secondary 'Sin → washing'. Remaining six passages all report being driven out, banished or removed.
